description:
A Nikke from the Electric Shock squad.
She's an expert in power sources of electronics, and her hobby is installing the classic FPS game, BOOM, on every device that has a screen.

lines.text: What are you up to today? Getting in a good BOOM session, I bet.
Do you have any faulty equipment that needs some fixing?
As long as I can play some BOOM, I could live up on the surface by myself forever.
Hehe, nothing gets the point across better than the Boomstick!
This game has all the emotional highs and lows you'd ever need, all in just 28 megabytes.
My dream is to install BOOM on every type of electronic device in the world.

You can leave me on my own, it's fine...
I'll just be here playing some BOOM...

How far along is the BOOM installation... 10%... 20%... Huh? What am I doing?
Nothing much. You can come back later.

Hot diggity dog, just the sight of this train is enough to get my blood pumping!
All aboard the train to the Outpost!

If Ms. Syuen comes around, just say you haven't seen me.
I installed BOOM on her cellphone, and she wasn't too pleased.

Why does that elevator break down every day?
Could it be a power shortage? I'll have to look into it.
I'm Elegg, and I'm a 12 outta 10!
This upgrade seems to be a success!
Hehe, I feel like I just got in a rousing round of BOOM.
It's like I can feel the power coursing through me!
Oh my gosh, is this a limited-edition BOOM gift pack?
Heh-heh, thanks. Is there anything that I could get you?
I will give you the honor of playing the great gaming classic BOOM with me.
Heh-heh, I knew I'd be happy with you.
Absent a catastrophic failure, we should be fine...
